prompt: A worn black pirate flag fills the square frame, and in its centre is a snarling red fox head facing forward with a long realistic muzzle, amber slit-pupil eyes and a wide grin of sharp ivory teeth. A blue scalloped rosette with an open eye sits in the middle of its forehead as a third eye, jagged dark-blue crystal shards rise behind its tall ears, a cold blue shadow runs down the right side of its face, and its ears are pierced: a large stretched black tunnel gauge at the base of each ear, black spiked hoops and a gold spiked ring along the ear rims. Behind and below the fox head, a steel chef's knife and a tattoo machine cross in a clear X like the crossed bones of a jolly roger, one pointing down-left and one pointing down-right. Semi-realistic painted graphic-novel comic art with heavy dark ink linework, diagonal hatching in the shadows and crosshatching in the deepest shadows, realistic painted shading and muted desaturated colour with deep red (#9E1A14) accents. The flag cloth is frayed at the edges and lit evenly from the front.
